oddities: Neutral palette split: calendar, profile, onboarding, privacy, terms use gray-*; help, feedback, graduation-guide use slate-*; patch-notes mixes text-gray-900 titles with slate-* body/meta.

Brand navy applied three ways: Tailwind arbitrary (text-[#153974]/bg-[#153974]), inline style={{ color: '#153974' }} / backgroundColor (calendar page only), and CSS utility text-gradient (onboarding h1).
#1a4a8f is a fourth blue outside the brand trio: hover:bg-[#1a4a8f] on primary buttons (help, feedback), gradient to-[#1a4a8f] on feedback mail tile, hover:text-[#1a4a8f] on terms back link.
Calendar primary buttons (일정 추가, modal submit) have transition-colors but no hover class.

Three different focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 (calendar modal inputs), focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#153974] focus:border-[#153974] (onboarding year select), focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00AACA]/20 focus:border-[#00AACA] (feedback textarea). Profile native <select> has no focus style at all.
Calendar '전체' active chip uses Tailwind bg-blue-600, not a brand color; checkbox uses text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500.

Modal overlay uses Tailwind v3 syntax 'bg-black bg-opacity-50' — bg-opacity-* was removed in Tailwind v4, so the overlay renders as opaque black; graduation-guide lightbox correctly uses bg-slate-950/85.

Active category filter chips carry border-*-200 color classes but no 'border' width utility, so no border renders in the active state while the inactive state has 'border border-gray-300' — chips shift by 1px when toggled.
exam uses red-* and holiday uses rose-* — adjacent hues that are hard to distinguish; holiday additionally gets a 🔴 emoji prefix.
Today marker is blue (bg-blue-50 border-blue-400/500) while selected day is amber (border-amber-300/400, ring-amber-400); mobile selected uses bg-amber-50/50 but desktop selected is md:bg-white.
md:ring-offset-0 is a no-op default.
Micro type on mobile calendar: text-[10px] day numbers/chips and text-[9px] overflow counter; text-gray-400 '+N' on white is roughly 2.5–3:1 contrast (fails AA).
text-slate-400 timestamps and char counter on white (~3:1) and text-slate-300 empty-state icons are low contrast.

Purple/orange are reserved for double major/minor in profile+onboarding, but purple is reused for unrelated patch-notes Megaphone tile and the feedback '내 문의 내역' pill and the guide STEP 3 FileText tile.
Emerald appears only in onboarding (completed stepper circle, step-2 card border-t, autofill notice) while success elsewhere uses green-* (feedback resolved, copy success).
Yellow (bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700) used for feedback pending while amber is used for warnings/guest mode/selected day — two near-identical warm hues.
Patch-notes version badge (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700) duplicates the calendar 'academic' chip colors; patch notes have no per-type tag colors at all.

Legal pages use a different background family (bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 / via-white) than the help pages (slate vertical gradient), and different card radii/shadows: privacy rounded-lg shadow-sm vs terms rounded-2xl shadow-xl.
privacy/page.tsx applies 'prose prose-sm max-w-none' (Tailwind Typography plugin classes) — with no tailwind.config and no @plugin in CSS these likely do nothing.

Three different back-link implementations: lucide ArrowLeft (help, patch-notes), inline SVG path (terms), and the literal '←' character (privacy). Guide back link is text-slate-600 hover:text-[#00AACA] (inverse of the usual teal→navy pattern).
Help '비회원/회원' lists use hand-typed '• ' bullets inside <li> instead of list-disc.
Terms 제8조 section: red-700 heading and red-700 li inside an amber-50/amber-300 box, with ⚠️ emoji in the heading.

border-b / border-t used without a color on key-value rows, column headers and patch-note divider — in Tailwind v4 default border color is currentColor, rendering a dark text-colored hairline rather than gray-200.
Profile cards use 'relative z-10' and 'relative z-[5]' z-index hacks so SearchableSelect dropdowns overlay the following card.
MajorTypeToggle JSX is copy-pasted three times (guest profile, auth profile, onboarding) rather than extracted.
Profile uses the Chrome lucide icon to represent a Google account.
Stepper has no-op utilities: gap-0, px-0.
Onboarding header subtitle uses -해주세요 while caption uses 해요체 '시작할 수 있어요' without a period; all other copy is 합니다체/-하세요 with periods.

FlowStep data has empty description and imageCaption strings, rendering empty

elements (mt-3 and px-4 py-3 caption bar).
Lightbox attaches both onPointerDown and onClick to close, and stops both on the image frame.
Buttons add explicit 'cursor-pointer' in feedback page (Tailwind v4 buttons default to cursor: default) but not in calendar/profile/onboarding raw <button>s.
Calendar event-detail Card combines class border-l-4 with inline style borderLeftColor '#00AACA'.
Hard-coded 'min-w-[3rem]' on the month label and 'min-h-[90px]' on day cells; 'aspect-[1425/436]' one-off ratio in guide.

Profile guest form uses the ui Input component for text fields but a raw <select> styled 'flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm' (rounded-md) next to rounded-lg buttons.
